questions.question: During validation:
questions.explanation: During validation the customer checks the product. Alpha, beta and acceptance testing are the ways of involving the customer during testing, and the product is judged against the customer's expectations.
questions.explanation_ar: في Validation الزبون هو من يفحص المنتج (Alpha وBeta وAcceptance كلها طرق لإشراك الزبون). الفخ: الخيار (b) Product is checked صحيح لغوياً لكنه لا يميّز Validation، ومفتاح الناشر هو (d).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.14; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Verification is
options: checking the product with respect to customer’s expectations
checking the product with respect to specifications
checking the product with respect to the constraints of the project
options_en: checking the product with respect to customer’s expectations
checking the product with respect to specifications
checking the product with respect to the constraints of the project
options_ar: checking the product with respect to customer’s expectations
checking the product with respect to specifications
checking the product with respect to the constraints of the project
questions.explanation: Verification is checking the product with respect to its specifications: evaluating whether the products of a development phase satisfy the conditions imposed at the start of that phase.
questions.explanation_ar: Verification: مطابقة ناتج كل مرحلة مع المواصفات والشروط التي وُضعت في بدايتها. أما مطابقة توقعات الزبون فهي Validation.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.15; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Validation is
options: checking the product with respect to customer’s expectations
checking the product with respect to specification
checking the product with respect to constraints of the project
options_en: checking the product with respect to customer’s expectations
checking the product with respect to specification
checking the product with respect to constraints of the project
options_ar: checking the product with respect to customer’s expectations
checking the product with respect to specification
checking the product with respect to constraints of the project
questions.explanation: Validation is checking the product with respect to the customer's expectation. The deck words it as evaluating the system during or at the end of development against the specified requirements; the key chooses the customer-expectation option.
questions.explanation_ar: Validation: مطابقة المنتج لتوقعات الزبون. تنبيه: صياغة السلايد 11 هي «specified requirements»، لكن مفتاح الناشر لهذا السؤال هو (a) فاعتمده.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.16; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Alpha testing is done by
questions.explanation: Alpha tests are conducted at the developer's site by some potential customers, in a controlled environment. The customer is therefore the keyed answer.
questions.explanation_ar: اختبار ألفا ينفذه زبائن محتملون في موقع المطور وبيئة متحكَّم بها. الفخ: لا تختر Developer لأن المفتاح (a) Customer.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.17; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Site for Alpha testing is
questions.explanation: The site for Alpha testing is the developer's site. It takes place in a controlled development setting where developers can directly monitor runtime behavior and immediately record diagnostic anomaly traces.
questions.explanation_ar: الموقع الحصري لاختبار ألفا هو موقع المطور (Developer's site) وبيئته الداخلية المتحكم بها.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.18; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Site of Beta testing is
questions.explanation: The site for Beta testing is the user's site. Software is distributed to real end users who execute it within their diverse, unmonitored production hardware and operating configurations.
questions.explanation_ar: موقع اختبار بيتا هو موقع المستخدم الفعلي (User's site) لضمان العمل على البيئات والأجهزة المتنوعة للعملاء.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.19; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Acceptance testing is done by
questions.question_ar: اختبار القبول acceptance testing يقوم به:
questions.explanation: Acceptance testing is conducted by the end user or customer. It is used when the software is developed for a specific customer, who runs a series of tests to validate all requirements; these may range from ad hoc tests to a well-planned systematic series.
questions.explanation_ar: اختبار القبول ينفذه الزبون أو المستخدم النهائي عندما يُطوَّر النظام لزبون محدد، وقد يكون عشوائياً أو منظماً.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.20; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: One fault may lead to
questions.explanation: One fault in software may lead to: (a) no failure (if unexecuted or masked), (b) a single failure, or (c) multiple failures across different operational runs. The manifestation of a fault depends dynamically on input data combinations and execution environment state.
questions.explanation_ar: العيب البرمجي الواحد (Fault) قد لا يسبب أي فشل إن لم يُنفذ المسار أو تم تمويه النتيجة، أو قد يسبب فشلاً واحداً، أو يسبب انهيارات متعددة متكررة في بيئات مختلفة.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.21; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Test suite is
questions.explanation: A test suite is a collection or set of test cases designed to test a program or module. It bundles inputs, execution conditions, and expected outcomes to verify compliance with a defined scope of requirements.
questions.explanation_ar: حزمة الاختبار (Test Suite) هي مجموعة منظمة من حالات الاختبار (Set of test cases) تُجمع وتُنفذ سوياً للتحقق من وحدة أو نظام كامل.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.22; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Behavioural specifications are required for:
questions.question_ar: المواصفات السلوكية behavioural specifications مطلوبة لـ:
questions.explanation: Publisher key: behavioral specifications are required for verification. The deck gives no sentence explaining this item, so it is a keyed fact; a behavioral specification is the reference the product's observable behavior is checked against.
questions.explanation_ar: المفتاح الرسمي هو (b) Verification. السلايدات لا تشرح السبب بجملة صريحة، لذا لا تجادل المفتاح في الامتحان؛ تذكّر أن الخيار الذي يطابق حرفه هو Verification وليس Validation.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.23; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: During the development phase, the following testing approach is not adopted
questions.question_ar: أثناء مرحلة التطوير، أي أسلوب اختبار لا يعتمد؟
questions.explanation: Acceptance testing is not adopted during the development phase. Unit, bottom-up and integration testing are development-time approaches; acceptance testing involves the customer and is done after unit and integration testing.
questions.explanation_ar: أثناء التطوير تُستخدم Unit وBottom-up وIntegration. اختبار القبول (Acceptance) يخص الزبون ويأتي بعدها، لذلك هو الخيار غير المعتمد (d).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.24; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Which is not a functional testing technique?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس تقنية اختبار وظيفي؟
questions.explanation: Regression testing is not a functional testing technique. Boundary value analysis and decision tables are functional (black-box) techniques; regression testing is re-testing after changes.
questions.explanation_ar: BVA وDecision table تقنيات وظيفية، أما Regression فهو إعادة اختبار بعد التعديل وليس تقنية لاشتقاق الحالات من المواصفات.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.25; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Decision tables are useful for describing situations in which:
options: an action is taken under varying sets of conditions
number of combinations of actions are taken under varying sets of conditions
no action is taken under varying sets of conditions
options_en: an action is taken under varying sets of conditions
number of combinations of actions are taken under varying sets of conditions
no action is taken under varying sets of conditions
questions.question_ar: جداول القرار decision tables مفيدة لوصف حالات يكون فيها:
options_ar: an action is taken under varying sets of conditions
number of combinations of actions are taken under varying sets of conditions
no action is taken under varying sets of conditions
questions.explanation: Decision tables are useful where a number of combinations of actions are taken under varying sets of conditions. They list conditions and actions as rules, so each combination of conditions is tied to its actions.
questions.explanation_ar: جداول القرار تناسب الحالات التي تتغير فيها مجموعة الشروط وتُنفَّذ تركيبات مختلفة من الإجراءات. الفخ: الخيار (a) يتحدث عن إجراء واحد فقط.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.26; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.
